allow: PowerShell(Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem "C:\\Program Files\\nodejs" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem "$env:APPDATA\\npm" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 5)

hooks.command:
H="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/block-bad-commands.sh"; [ -r "$H" ] || { printf 'hook: %s is unreadable -- the command guard did NOT run
' "$H" >&2; exit 0; }; c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); [ -n "$c" ] || exit 0; set -f; set -- $c; out=$(bash "$H" "${1:-}" "$c"); rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && exit 0; printf '%s
' "$out" >&2; exit 2
hooks.statusMessage: Blocking force-push to main, .env commits, unapproved ElevenLabs...

hooks.command:
H="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/guard-file-writes.sh"; [ -r "$H" ] || { printf 'hook: %s is unreadable -- the line-budget guard did NOT run
' "$H" >&2; exit 0; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in *.md) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; out=$(bash "$H" "$f" "$(cat "$f")"); rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then [ -n "$out" ] && printf '%s
' "$out"; exit 0; else printf '%s
' "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi

H="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/validate-after-write.sh"; [ -r "$H" ] || { printf 'hook: %s is unreadable -- the syntax check did NOT run
' "$H" >&2; exit 0; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); { [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; } || exit 0; out=$(bash "$H" "$f"); rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then [ -n "$out" ] && printf '%s
' "$out"; exit 0; else printf '%s
' "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Validating Python syntax and markdown frontmatter...

hooks.command: H="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/capture-active-session-changes.sh"; [ -r "$H" ] || exit 0; p=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *active-session.md) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; o=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.tool_input.old_string // empty'); [ -n "$o" ] || exit 0; bash "$H" "$f" "$o" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

H="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/capture-tool-failures.sh"; [ -r "$H" ] || exit 0; p=$(cat); n=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty'); r=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r 'if .tool_response then (.tool_response | if type=="string" then . else tojson end) elif .error then (.error|tostring) else empty end'); [ -n "$r" ] || exit 0; bash "$H" "$n" "$r" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

hooks.statusMessage: Checking open beads and unstaged changes...

hooks.command: H="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/capture-tool-failures.sh"; [ -r "$H" ] || exit 0; p=$(cat); n=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty'); r=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '[.error?, (.tool_response? | if type=="string" then . else tojson end)] | map(select(. != null)) | join(" ")'); [ -n "$r" ] || exit 0; bash "$H" "$n" "$r" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
